Cyber Infidelity

By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Technology has changed how we meet and connect with people, date and even cheat.. We look into the world of cyber infidelity.

Summary:
Through online dating sites and social media apps like Ashley Madison, Tinder, Facebook, and Whatsapp traditional models of courting has evolved as the world has moved from hand holding to hand held devices. A new relationship is now just a click away, sex can be delivered right to your doorstep with the press of a button and cheating has never been so accessible or appealing. Within the cyber environment, the lines regarding infidelity, monogamy and commitment are increasingly blurred as they challenge traditional relationship models. This is the world of cyber infidelity - the newest form of seduction.


In this story we look at how the world of online and social media interaction is changing dating, focusing specifically on cheating.

Further information:
The narrative structure will include:

• An introduction to the various forms of cyber dating / cheating platforms.
• Branching out and focusing on cheating.. With the assistance of 3 -4 case studies who have cheated using Ashley Madison, Facebook and Tinder. These are all marrie people who had affairs through these platforms.
• Through re-enactments of whatsapp messages, Tinder, online and people engaging physically we will also tell stories from my cybersecret.com and testimonials from Dr Eve’s book about how people are even using cyber platforms to express themselves more freely and even trick their partners into cheating or to test their fidelity.
• Dr Eve takes us through the latest research on cyber infidelity as she prepares to release her book – the first of its kind on this subject with groundbreaking research which she compiled over the course of 2 years. Which also included her taking on a male and female identity online..
• She speaks to us about the impact that cyber infidelity is having on the evolution of relationships and monogamy and our traditional understanding of what constitutes cheating.. Just because your affair may be virtual does not mean it doesn’t hurt..
• We speak to clinical psychologist Leonard Carr for a different point of view as we look at a different take on cyber infidelity.
• And we speak to a social media expert (TBC) on how social media has changed our behavior and the limitless ways we can promote ourselves and engage in seduction.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Technology has changed how we meet and connect with people, date and even cheat.. We look into the world of cyber infidelity.
metadata.Summary: Through online dating sites and social media apps like Ashley Madison, Tinder, Facebook, and Whatsapp traditional models of courting has evolved as the world has moved from hand holding to hand held devices. A new relationship is now just a click away, sex can be delivered right to your doorstep with the press of a button and cheating has never been so accessible or appealing. Within the cyber environment, the lines regarding infidelity, monogamy and commitment are increasingly blurred as they challenge traditional relationship models. This is the world of cyber infidelity - the newest form of seduction. In this story we look at how the world of online and social media interaction is changing dating, focusing specifically on cheating.
metadata.Further information: The narrative structure will include: • An introduction to the various forms of cyber dating / cheating platforms. • Branching out and focusing on cheating.. With the assistance of 3 -4 case studies who have cheated using Ashley Madison, Facebook and Tinder. These are all marrie people who had affairs through these platforms. • Through re-enactments of whatsapp messages, Tinder, online and people engaging physically we will also tell stories from my cybersecret.com and testimonials from Dr Eve’s book about how people are even using cyber platforms to express themselves more freely and even trick their partners into cheating or to test their fidelity. • Dr Eve takes us through the latest research on cyber infidelity as she prepares to release her book – the first of its kind on this subject with groundbreaking research which she compiled over the course of 2 years. Which also included her taking on a male and female identity online.. • She speaks to us about the impact that cyber infidelity is having on the evolution of relationships and monogamy and our traditional understanding of what constitutes cheating.. Just because your affair may be virtual does not mean it doesn’t hurt.. • We speak to clinical psychologist Leonard Carr for a different point of view as we look at a different take on cyber infidelity. • And we speak to a social media expert (TBC) on how social media has changed our behavior and the limitless ways we can promote ourselves and engage in seduction.
